subject.title: Feature Request: Stream Repetition Safeguard (Halt & Confirm)

question: Should OpenClaw add a core stream-output repetition circuit breaker, and should it abort-and-notify, retry/fallback, or pause for manual approve/cancel when it fires?
rationale: The detector can be implemented, but the requested halt-and-confirm UX affects delivery, transcript/session state, false-positive policy, and recovery semantics that cleanup automation should not choose alone.

options.title: Ship Conservative Abort And Notify
options.body: Add a default core guard that stops repeated-output turns, drops buffered repeated text, notifies the user, and quarantines/sanitizes the turn without trying to resume the same corrupted stream.

options.title: Design Full Halt And Resume
options.body: Specify pause, approve, cancel, resume, and fallback semantics before implementation, accepting a larger state-machine and channel-delivery design.

options.title: Keep To Existing Timeout Work
options.body: Decline semantic repetition detection for now and rely on https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/8724 plus provider/run timeout work, leaving pure text loops partially uncovered.

recommendation.title: Ship Conservative Abort And Notify
recommendation.body: Add a default core guard that stops repeated-output turns, drops buffered repeated text, notifies the user, and quarantines/sanitizes the turn without trying to resume the same corrupted stream.
